description: This file defines a singleton object 'OpenClawCanvasA2UIAction' that contains utility functions for extracting and sanitizing user actions, formatting messages for UI communication, and generating JavaScript code for dispatching UI action status events within an Android application.

classes.name: OpenClawCanvasA2UIAction
classes.description: A singleton object providing static utility methods for handling UI actions, message formatting, and event dispatching relevant to OpenClaw Canvas interactions within an Android context.

methods.name: extractActionName
methods.description: Extracts the 'name' or 'action' string from a user action JSON object, trimming whitespace and returning null if absent or empty.

methods.name: sanitizeTagValue
methods.description: Sanitizes a string to be used as a tag or identifier by trimming, replacing spaces with underscores, and replacing disallowed characters with underscores.

methods.name: formatAgentMessage
methods.description: Creates a formatted string message containing various sanitized parameters for communication with the UI, optionally including context JSON if provided.

methods.name: jsDispatchA2UIActionStatus
methods.description: Generates a JavaScript snippet to dispatch a custom event indicating the status of an UI action, including success or error info.
